articles.title: India and Germany sign deals to deepen economic and security ties
articles.mainIdea: India and Germany sign deals to deepen economic and security ties
articles.summary: Associated Press Finance: India and Germany sign deals to deepen economic and security ties. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz met on Monday in western Gujarat state to push for deeper economic and security ties between the South Asian nation and Europe’s largest economy. Modi and Merz held talks in the city of Gandhinagar, where the two countries signed various agreements to enhance cooperation in the defense sector, skill development, health and education, as both nations seek to reduce dependence on China and bolster economic ties. After the bilateral talks, Modi noted that Germany is India’s most important trading partner in the European Union and said both leaders were seeking to expand those ties.
